symptom: The restored backend source failed its production build with strict property initialization and implicit-any callback diagnostics.
evidence: The bounded build reported ORM-managed entity properties without definite-assignment declarations and two untyped CORS callback parameters.

root_cause.summary: The restored entities and CORS options did not satisfy the committed strict TypeScript configuration.

actions: Added definite-assignment declarations to ORM-managed entity properties without changing schema metadata.
Contextually typed the CORS configuration through Nest CorsOptions.
reusable_resolution: Represent framework-hydrated TypeORM properties explicitly and type CORS options without weakening compiler strictness.
prevention: Validate the sanitized backend baseline with the permitted production build before freezing it.
